name: Thomas pulse (decelerating FM, bilateral)
summary: Decelerating frequency-modulated pattern (~25 -> 6 Hz, 3 ms points, ~2.5 s) from the Thomas/Persinger patents, studied mainly for analgesia and relaxation. Synthesised from the description; the original point file is not public.
source: Thomas & Persinger patents (e.g. US6234953) ; Buckner et al. 2015 (Thomas-EMF 25-6 Hz)
